items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay says he felt lack of power/explosion Thursday, will test pregame. Crucial DFS status.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle); limited practice all week, trending toward play but GTD per coach.

items.implication: If OUT Huntley starts; Ravens offense downgrade

items.text: Bijan Robinson full workload + sweet SF DvP (inflates opp RB 4.4%, 7th most) with Brian Robinson OUT; recent SF RB receptions high.
